name: secnix-htask
description: Repo-level tooling only (git hooks, commit linting). Apps live in apps/*.

scripts.test:api: docker compose exec -T api composer check
scripts.test:web: docker compose exec -T web npm run check
scripts.test:load: docker compose exec -T api php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force && node scripts/load-test.mjs
scripts.contracts:export: docker compose exec -T api php artisan contracts:export > apps/web/src/contracts/generated.ts && docker compose exec -T api php artisan contracts:export --schema > contracts/schemas/enums.schema.json
